card.title: One Loss from Irrelevance
card.instruction: Project confidence while treating every setback as proof your standing could vanish. Regain control by raising the importance of the next result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That lost chess game was practice. This rematch will establish my reputation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've played here for thirty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I won't have thirty years remembered for one dropped rook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll make it. One excellent pot and you'll remember why you keep coming back.

mechanism: A protects standing after a chess loss by making the rematch decisive, then transfers the reputation test to tea when B declines chess.
confusable: Unlike ordinary desire to win, A interprets one setback as possible erasure of longstanding worth and magnifies the next available result.
comparison: The chess alternative shifts the proving ground into hospitality; the karaoke alternative shifts from recorded score to an unaccompanied booking audition.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
